Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `/Volumes/Models/ds4/.workspaces/server-agent-day-20261004/fresh32-visible/dedupe/solution.py`.

It tracks the last accepted timestamp per exact key, accepts first occurrences, accepts later occurrences only when `t - last_accepted >= ttl`, rejects otherwise without refreshing the stored timestamp, and returns `{"accepted": [...], "rejected": [...]}` using original payload indices.
